about.title: About Me
about.intro: As an engineering student at EPITA, I specialize in image-related fields: computer vision, artificial intelligence and GPU computing. My projects range from CUDA ports of real-time algorithms to medical and heritage image segmentation, always with the same discipline: measure, profile, validate. In parallel, five months at Studiocanal gave me hands-on production experience — CI/CD on AWS, Agile teamwork, code shipped and maintained. I am now looking for a 6-month final-year internship starting in early February 2027.
